Purpose
Text: DEL-08-01 exists to make instruction-root packaging and agent conformance explicit and repeatable. It supports OBJ-007 by maintaining agent-suite integrity and governed subagent delegation without expanding authority, and OBJ-008 by keeping validation and instruction-root checks repeatable. Source: decomposition DEL-08-01, OBJ-007, OBJ-008.

Source: `docs/DIRECTIVE.md` section 2.7; `docs/SPEC.md` section 1.1. - Validate conformance from source files and registries, not from narrative counts. Source: `docs/PRD.md` KG-013 with hash warning. - Keep the validator conservative. Missing source evidence becomes `TBD`, warning, or failure depending on the governing source; it must not be silently accepted. Source: `docs/CONTRACT.md` K-INVENT-1 and K-CONFLICT-1. - Separate conformance validation from runtime capability implementation. DEL-08-01 verifies packaging and instruction conformance; DEL-08-04 and DEL-08-05 cover subagent bridge execution and child records. Source: decomposition PKG-08 rows. - Preserve source authority labels.
